title: My Daughter And Son-In-Law Stole My $95K And Fired Me. So I Tipped Off The IRS And Bought Their Diner.
description: After my daughter and her husband drained my $95K 401(k) to buy a failing diner, promised me a partnership, then fired me and claimed I was only a lender, I tipped off the IRS about their cash catering scheme. A $210K whistleblower reward and a tax auction later, I now run Traitor's Gyros in the same spot, and every receipt prints the case number that proved they cooked the books. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #TaxJustice
thumb_text: THEY FIRED ME. I BOUGHT THEIR DINER FOR $34K.
pinned_comment: If your daughter and son-in-law wiped out your $95K 401(k) and then fired you from the diner you helped save, calling you just a lender, would you have tipped off the IRS like I did? Share your story in the comments.
